usageNote: 比较句型！drier是dry的比较级，说地区气候差异超常用，听起来很地道！

examples.en: The south part is drier than the north, so farmers there need to irrigate more.
examples.zh: 南部比北部更干燥，所以那里的农民需要更多灌溉。

examples.en: Travelers should know the south part is drier than the north before packing.
examples.zh: 旅行者出发前应该知道南部比北部更干燥。
